issuer: the Registrar of driving licences (Έφορος) at the Road Transport Department
note: Read 2026-10-30 on CyLaw, the consolidated text of the Driving Licence Law (Ο περί Άδειας Οδήγησης Νόμος, 94(I)/2001, as amended): category B from 18 (s. 6(1)(b)); a licence for categories AM, A1, A2, A, B, B1 and BE is issued for fifteen years, until 70 after 55 (s. 10). The page is in the Windows-1253 encoding; the copy checked is that page converted to UTF-8, word for word. The law's fee schedule (Annex C) still gives the grant of a licence to someone under 60 in Cyprus pounds (£35.00), from before the euro; the fee charged now in euros wasn't read, so the fee is null. The learner's licence and the tests aren't held. The identity card is the ids engine's.
